name: admcp
description: Local-first MCP server for Android debugging via ADB, JDI, LLDB, and Flutter.
long_description:
admcp gives MCP clients direct access to a connected Android device or emulator. It exposes 51 tools for device discovery, UI hierarchy inspection, screenshots, logcat, file and process operations, JDI/LLDB debugging, Flutter/DAP debugging, Perfetto analysis, and diagnostics.

Requirements: JDK 21, Android SDK platform-tools with adb, and a connected device or emulator. The MCP client must be able to launch local processes.
